entries.key: Too many attempts — try again in {{duration}}
entries.english: Too many attempts — try again in {{duration}}
entries.translation: Demasiados intentos — vuelve a intentarlo en {{duration}}

entries.key: Incorrect PIN. Attempts remaining before Sidecar erases itself: {{count}}
entries.english: Incorrect PIN. Attempts remaining before Sidecar erases itself: {{count}}
entries.translation: PIN incorrecto. Intentos restantes antes de que Sidecar borre sus datos: {{count}}
El almacén de claves está bloqueado

entries.key: Too many failed attempts — Sidecar has been erased
entries.english: Too many failed attempts — Sidecar has been erased
entries.translation: Demasiados intentos fallidos — se han borrado los datos de Sidecar

entries.key: That looks like a secret key. For safety, paste your nsec only into the key import field.
entries.english: That looks like a secret key. For safety, paste your nsec only into the key import field.
entries.translation: Eso parece una clave secreta. Por seguridad, pega tu nsec únicamente en el campo de importación de claves.

entries.key: Too many attempts. All data on this device was erased.
entries.english: Too many attempts. All data on this device was erased.
entries.translation: Demasiados intentos. Se han borrado todos los datos de este dispositivo.

entries.key: If you've lost your PIN there is no way to recover it. You can erase everything and start fresh: all accounts and private keys, wallet connections, permissions, and settings on this device are gone for good. Any account without a backed-up nsec cannot be recovered.
entries.english: If you've lost your PIN there is no way to recover it. You can erase everything and start fresh: all accounts and private keys, wallet connections, permissions, and settings on this device are gone for good. Any account without a backed-up nsec cannot be recovered.
entries.translation: Si has perdido tu PIN, no hay forma de recuperarlo. Puedes borrarlo todo y empezar de nuevo: todas las cuentas y claves privadas, conexiones de billeteras, permisos y ajustes de este dispositivo se eliminarán para siempre. Las cuentas cuyo nsec no tenga una copia de seguridad no podrán recuperarse.

entries.key: Scan or copy to pay from any wallet.
entries.english: Scan or copy to pay from any wallet.
entries.translation: Escanea o copia para pagar desde cualquier billetera.

entries.key: Scan or copy to pay from any CLINK wallet.
entries.english: Scan or copy to pay from any CLINK wallet.
entries.translation: Escanea o copia para pagar desde cualquier billetera CLINK.

entries.key: Scan or copy to show someone how to pay you.
entries.english: Scan or copy to show someone how to pay you.
entries.translation: Escanea o copia para mostrarle a alguien cómo pagarte.

entries.key: Sidecar generated a new account. This nsec is the only way to recover it — save it now. You can view it again later behind your PIN.
entries.english: Sidecar generated a new account. This nsec is the only way to recover it — save it now. You can view it again later behind your PIN.
entries.translation: Sidecar ha generado una cuenta nueva. Este nsec es la única forma de recuperarla — guárdalo ahora. Podrás volver a verlo más tarde con tu PIN.

entries.key: Incorrect password, or not a valid ncryptsec key.
entries.english: Incorrect password, or not a valid ncryptsec key.
entries.translation: Contraseña incorrecta o clave ncryptsec no válida.

entries.key: That QR code is not a private key
entries.english: That QR code is not a private key
entries.translation: Ese código QR no es una clave privada

entries.key: No QR code found in that image
entries.english: No QR code found in that image
entries.translation: No se encontró ningún código QR en esa imagen

entries.key: Your nsec stays encrypted on this device. Sidecar signs locally, so sites only get signatures, never your key. Much safer than pasting it into a website.
entries.english: Your nsec stays encrypted on this device. Sidecar signs locally, so sites only get signatures, never your key. Much safer than pasting it into a website.
entries.translation: Tu nsec permanece cifrado en este dispositivo. Sidecar firma localmente, de modo que los sitios solo reciben firmas, nunca tu clave. Es mucho más seguro que pegarla en un sitio web.

entries.key: Enter an nsec, ncryptsec, or hex private key.
entries.english: Enter an nsec, ncryptsec, or hex private key.
entries.translation: Introduce una clave privada nsec, ncryptsec o hexadecimal.

entries.key: Hiding in {{seconds}}s. Reveal again with your PIN.
entries.english: Hiding in {{seconds}}s. Reveal again with your PIN.
entries.translation: Se ocultará en {{seconds}} s. Muéstralo de nuevo con tu PIN.

entries.key: Scan to sign in on a mobile client that supports QR login.
entries.english: Scan to sign in on a mobile client that supports QR login.
entries.translation: Escanea para iniciar sesión en un cliente móvil compatible con acceso por QR.

entries.key: Anyone with this key fully controls the account. Store it somewhere safe and never share it.
entries.english: Anyone with this key fully controls the account. Store it somewhere safe and never share it.
entries.translation: Cualquiera que tenga esta clave controla por completo la cuenta. Guárdala en un lugar seguro y nunca la compartas.

entries.key: Saved — store it safely, never by email
entries.english: Saved — store it safely, never by email
entries.translation: Guardado — guárdalo de forma segura, nunca por correo electrónico

entries.key: This password is unique to the sheet — choose a new one, not one you use anywhere else.
entries.english: This password is unique to the sheet — choose a new one, not one you use anywhere else.
entries.translation: Esta contraseña es exclusiva de la hoja — elige una nueva que no uses en ningún otro lugar.

entries.key: This unlocks the printed sheet. It is not your Sidecar PIN.
entries.english: This unlocks the printed sheet. It is not your Sidecar PIN.
entries.translation: Esto desbloquea la hoja impresa. No es tu PIN de Sidecar.

entries.key: Use a password of at least 8 characters.
entries.english: Use a password of at least 8 characters.
entries.translation: Usa una contraseña de al menos 8 caracteres.

entries.key: One page with your key and a QR code. Print it, or keep the file somewhere safe.
entries.english: One page with your key and a QR code. Print it, or keep the file somewhere safe.
entries.translation: Una página con tu clave y un código QR. Imprímela o guarda el archivo en un lugar seguro.
Este PIN no se puede recuperar

entries.key: Write it down, or save it in a password manager, before you go any further. {{warning}}. Only a separate backup of your keys can get your accounts back.
entries.english: Write it down, or save it in a password manager, before you go any further. {{warning}}. Only a separate backup of your keys can get your accounts back.
entries.translation: Anótalo o guárdalo en un gestor de contraseñas antes de continuar. {{warning}}. Solo una copia de seguridad independiente de tus claves te permitirá recuperar tus cuentas.
Guarda tu PIN en un lugar seguro

entries.key: Enter your PIN to build a printable backup sheet for {{name}}.
entries.english: Enter your PIN to build a printable backup sheet for {{name}}.
entries.translation: Introduce tu PIN para crear una hoja de respaldo imprimible para {{name}}.

entries.key: Enter your PIN to reveal the key for {{name}}.
entries.english: Enter your PIN to reveal the key for {{name}}.
entries.translation: Introduce tu PIN para revelar la clave de {{name}}.

entries.key: This is not the same as your nsec — it won't work anywhere that only accepts a plain nsec. Choose a password to encrypt it with; you'll need to give this exact password to wherever you import it.
entries.english: This is not the same as your nsec — it won't work anywhere that only accepts a plain nsec. Choose a password to encrypt it with; you'll need to give this exact password to wherever you import it.
entries.translation: Esto no es lo mismo que tu nsec — no funcionará donde solo se acepte un nsec sin cifrar. Elige una contraseña para cifrarlo; tendrás que introducir exactamente esa contraseña donde lo importes.

entries.key: Anyone with this ncryptsec and the password fully controls the account. Store them somewhere safe, separately from each other.
entries.english: Anyone with this ncryptsec and the password fully controls the account. Store them somewhere safe, separately from each other.
entries.translation: Cualquiera que tenga este ncryptsec y la contraseña controla por completo la cuenta. Guárdalos en lugares seguros y separados.

entries.key: Scan to import into another NIP-49-compatible app.
entries.english: Scan to import into another NIP-49-compatible app.
entries.translation: Escanea para importar en otra aplicación compatible con NIP-49.

entries.key: Two formats of the same key for {{name}}: nsec works with most apps; ncryptsec is password-protected, for apps that support it.
entries.english: Two formats of the same key for {{name}}: nsec works with most apps; ncryptsec is password-protected, for apps that support it.
entries.translation: Dos formatos de la misma clave de {{name}}: nsec funciona con la mayoría de las aplicaciones; ncryptsec está protegido con contraseña y requiere una aplicación compatible.

entries.key: Removing {{name}} deletes its encrypted key from this device. Make sure you have a backup of the nsec. This cannot be undone.
entries.english: Removing {{name}} deletes its encrypted key from this device. Make sure you have a backup of the nsec. This cannot be undone.
entries.translation: Al eliminar {{name}}, se borra su clave cifrada de este dispositivo. Asegúrate de tener una copia de seguridad del nsec. Esta acción no se puede deshacer.
clave de dispositivo para mensajes directos
transferencia de clave para mensajes directos
clave de cifrado de mensajes directos
lista de relays de mensajes directos

entries.key: Posts may not match the client.
entries.english: Posts may not match the client.
entries.translation: Las publicaciones pueden no coincidir con la cuenta del cliente.
Se rechazó una solicitud de firma ilegible

entries.key: Forget every site? Pairings, permission tiers, and Recent activity are erased.
entries.english: Forget every site? Pairings, permission tiers, and Recent activity are erased.
entries.translation: ¿Olvidar todos los sitios? Se borrarán las vinculaciones, los niveles de permisos y la actividad reciente.

entries.key: Enter your PIN to export every account on this device.
entries.english: Enter your PIN to export every account on this device.
entries.translation: Introduce tu PIN para exportar todas las cuentas de este dispositivo.

entries.key: Choose a password to encrypt the vault file. Use something other than your Sidecar PIN — you'll need this exact password to restore it.
entries.english: Choose a password to encrypt the vault file. Use something other than your Sidecar PIN — you'll need this exact password to restore it.
entries.translation: Elige una contraseña para cifrar el archivo de la bóveda. Usa una distinta de tu PIN de Sidecar — necesitarás exactamente esa contraseña para restaurarlo.
Contraseña de exportación de la bóveda

entries.key: Incorrect password, or a corrupted file.
entries.english: Incorrect password, or a corrupted file.

entries.key: Enter the password this vault was exported with. Accounts already on this device are left untouched.
entries.english: Enter the password this vault was exported with. Accounts already on this device are left untouched.
entries.translation: Introduce la contraseña con la que se exportó esta bóveda. Las cuentas que ya están en este dispositivo no se modificarán.

entries.key: Restoring an old follow list re-follows the accounts it holds. That is mostly benign.
entries.english: Restoring an old follow list re-follows the accounts it holds. That is mostly benign.
entries.translation: Restaurar una lista antigua de seguidos vuelve a seguir las cuentas que contiene. Por lo general, no supone un problema.

entries.key: This re-silences accounts you may have unmuted since: a moderation action taken on your behalf.
entries.english: This re-silences accounts you may have unmuted since: a moderation action taken on your behalf.
entries.translation: Esto vuelve a silenciar cuentas que quizá hayas dejado de silenciar: una acción de moderación en tu nombre.

entries.key: This replaces your current profile fields with this version’s.
entries.english: This replaces your current profile fields with this version’s.
entries.translation: Esto reemplaza los campos de tu perfil actual por los de esta versión.

entries.key: Restoring an old bookmark list affects nobody but you.
entries.english: Restoring an old bookmark list affects nobody but you.
entries.translation: Restaurar una lista antigua de marcadores solo te afecta a ti.

entries.key: Restoring these keys means clients will encrypt direct messages to them again.
entries.english: Restoring these keys means clients will encrypt direct messages to them again.
entries.translation: Restaurar estas claves hace que los clientes vuelvan a cifrar los mensajes directos para ellas.

entries.key: This announces you no longer use NIP-4e, so clients stop encrypting direct messages to your keys.
entries.english: This announces you no longer use NIP-4e, so clients stop encrypting direct messages to your keys.
entries.translation: Esto anuncia que ya no usas NIP-4e, por lo que los clientes dejan de cifrar mensajes directos para tus claves.

entries.key: Your current version lists keys that clients encrypt direct messages to.
entries.english: Your current version lists keys that clients encrypt direct messages to.
entries.translation: Tu versión actual incluye claves para las que los clientes cifran mensajes directos.

entries.key: Your current empty version announces that you do not use NIP-4e.
entries.english: Your current empty version announces that you do not use NIP-4e.
entries.translation: Tu versión actual vacía anuncia que no usas NIP-4e.

entries.key: An old relay list can strand you on dead relays and silently break delivery. Check them first.
entries.english: An old relay list can strand you on dead relays and silently break delivery. Check them first.
entries.translation: Una lista antigua de relays puede dejarte usando relays inactivos e interrumpir la entrega sin avisar. Compruébalos primero.

entries.key: A wrong DM inbox list silently breaks direct-message delivery. Check the relays first.
entries.english: A wrong DM inbox list silently breaks direct-message delivery. Check the relays first.
entries.translation: Una lista incorrecta de recepción de mensajes directos interrumpe la entrega sin avisar. Comprueba los relays primero.

entries.key: Low stakes: this only re-blocks relays you had blocked.
entries.english: Low stakes: this only re-blocks relays you had blocked.
entries.translation: Riesgo bajo: solo vuelve a bloquear relays que habías bloqueado.

entries.key: This version’s encrypted items couldn’t be read, so the counts leave private items out.
entries.english: This version’s encrypted items couldn’t be read, so the counts leave private items out.
entries.translation: No se pudieron leer los elementos cifrados de esta versión, por lo que los recuentos excluyen los elementos privados.

entries.key: Your current encrypted items couldn’t be read. Restoring replaces them, so some may be lost.
entries.english: Your current encrypted items couldn’t be read. Restoring replaces them, so some may be lost.
entries.translation: No se pudieron leer tus elementos cifrados actuales. Al restaurar se reemplazan, por lo que algunos podrían perderse.

entries.key: This republishes {{what}} everywhere and can’t be automatically undone.
entries.english: This republishes {{what}} everywhere and can’t be automatically undone.
entries.translation: Esto vuelve a publicar {{what}} en todas partes y no puede deshacerse automáticamente.

entries.key: Your current version changed while you reviewed. The counts below are against the new one.
entries.english: Your current version changed while you reviewed. The counts below are against the new one.
entries.translation: Tu versión actual cambió mientras revisabas. Los recuentos siguientes se comparan con la nueva versión.

entries.key: Adds {{added}}, removes {{removed}} against your current list.
entries.english: Adds {{added}}, removes {{removed}} against your current list.
entries.translation: Añade {{added}} y elimina {{removed}} respecto a tu lista actual.

entries.key: {{What}} has encrypted items Sidecar couldn’t read. Restoring replaces them everywhere.
entries.english: {{What}} has encrypted items Sidecar couldn’t read. Restoring replaces them everywhere.
entries.translation: {{What}} contiene elementos cifrados que Sidecar no pudo leer. La restauración los reemplaza en todas partes.

entries.key: Do you mean to stop using NIP-4e encryption keys?
entries.english: Do you mean to stop using NIP-4e encryption keys?
entries.translation: ¿Quieres dejar de usar claves de cifrado NIP-4e?

entries.key: Do you want direct messages encrypted to these keys again?
entries.english: Do you want direct messages encrypted to these keys again?
entries.translation: ¿Quieres que los mensajes directos vuelvan a cifrarse para estas claves?

entries.key: Signing came back for a different account, so nothing was published.
entries.english: Signing came back for a different account, so nothing was published.
entries.translation: La firma correspondía a otra cuenta, por lo que no se publicó nada.

entries.key: Sidecar’s wipe check flagged this restore.
entries.english: Sidecar’s wipe check flagged this restore.
entries.translation: La comprobación de borrado de Sidecar marcó esta restauración.
No se pudo confirmar la versión actual

entries.key: No write relay answered, so Sidecar can’t confirm your current version. Nothing was signed.
entries.english: No write relay answered, so Sidecar can’t confirm your current version. Nothing was signed.
entries.translation: Ningún relay de escritura respondió, así que Sidecar no puede confirmar tu versión actual. No se firmó nada.

entries.key: Restoring now may overwrite edits made since your review. Sidecar won’t remember this choice.
entries.english: Restoring now may overwrite edits made since your review. Sidecar won’t remember this choice.
entries.translation: Restaurar ahora podría sobrescribir cambios posteriores a tu revisión. Sidecar no recordará esta elección.

entries.key: Export your secret key as copyable text or an encrypted ncryptsec, or print it as a one-page sheet. This IS your key — never send it by email or chat.
entries.english: Export your secret key as copyable text or an encrypted ncryptsec, or print it as a one-page sheet. This IS your key — never send it by email or chat.
entries.translation: Exporta tu clave secreta como texto copiable o como ncryptsec cifrado, o imprímela en una hoja. Esta ES tu clave — nunca la envíes por correo electrónico ni chat.

entries.key: No wallet connection saved for this account
entries.english: No wallet connection saved for this account
entries.translation: No hay conexión de billetera guardada para esta cuenta

entries.key: Enter your PIN to reveal the NWC connection string for this account.
entries.english: Enter your PIN to reveal the NWC connection string for this account.
entries.translation: Introduce tu PIN para revelar la cadena de conexión NWC de esta cuenta.
Cadena de conexión de la billetera

entries.key: Copy the string to connect the same wallet elsewhere, or show a QR to scan it into an NWC-compatible app.
entries.english: Copy the string to connect the same wallet elsewhere, or show a QR to scan it into an NWC-compatible app.
entries.translation: Copia la cadena para conectar la misma billetera en otro lugar, o muestra un QR para escanearlo en una aplicación compatible con NWC.

entries.key: Scan in an NWC-compatible app to connect the same wallet.
entries.english: Scan in an NWC-compatible app to connect the same wallet.
entries.translation: Escanea en una aplicación compatible con NWC para conectar la misma billetera.

entries.key: This string can spend from your wallet up to its limits. Store it safely and never share it.
entries.english: This string can spend from your wallet up to its limits. Store it safely and never share it.
entries.translation: Esta cadena permite gastar de tu billetera hasta sus límites. Guárdala de forma segura y nunca la compartas.

entries.key: Sites allowed to pay from your wallet without asking, up to a daily budget. Revoke any time.
entries.english: Sites allowed to pay from your wallet without asking, up to a daily budget. Revoke any time.
entries.translation: Sitios autorizados a pagar desde tu billetera sin preguntar, hasta un presupuesto diario. Puedes revocarlo cuando quieras.

entries.key: No sites have a spending budget. Tick “remember a budget” when you approve a payment.
entries.english: No sites have a spending budget. Tick “remember a budget” when you approve a payment.
entries.translation: Ningún sitio tiene un presupuesto de gastos. Marca «recordar un presupuesto» al aprobar un pago.
No se pudieron cargar los presupuestos.

entries.key: Enter a daily budget in sats.
entries.english: Enter a daily budget in sats.
entries.translation: Introduce un presupuesto diario en sats.

entries.key: Daily amount {{host}} can spend without a prompt. Saving resets the remaining amount for today.
entries.english: Daily amount {{host}} can spend without a prompt. Saving resets the remaining amount for today.
entries.translation: Cantidad diaria que {{host}} puede gastar sin preguntar. Guardar restablece la cantidad restante de hoy.

entries.key: This wallet does not accept comments
entries.english: This wallet does not accept comments

entries.key: This invoice has already been paid
entries.english: This invoice has already been paid
entries.translation: Esta factura ya se ha pagado
Esta factura no se puede leer correctamente

entries.key: Check it was copied whole, or ask for a new one.
entries.english: Check it was copied whole, or ask for a new one.
entries.translation: Comprueba que se copió completa o pide una nueva.

entries.key: Ask the recipient for a new one.
entries.english: Ask the recipient for a new one.

entries.key: No amount set, enter one below
entries.english: No amount set, enter one below
entries.translation: No hay cantidad establecida, introduce una abajo
No se pudo comprobar esa dirección

entries.key: Check the spelling, or paste an invoice instead.
entries.english: Check the spelling, or paste an invoice instead.
entries.translation: Comprueba la escritura o pega una factura en su lugar.

entries.key: Paste an invoice or lightning address.
entries.english: Paste an invoice or lightning address.
entries.translation: Pega una factura o dirección Lightning.

entries.key: That invoice doesn't read correctly. Check it was copied whole.
entries.english: That invoice doesn't read correctly. Check it was copied whole.
entries.translation: Esta factura no se puede leer correctamente. Comprueba que se copió completa.

entries.key: This invoice has expired. Ask for a new one.
entries.english: This invoice has expired. Ask for a new one.
entries.translation: Esta factura ha vencido. Pide una nueva.

entries.key: This invoice has already been paid.
entries.english: This invoice has already been paid.
entries.translation: Esta factura ya se ha pagado.

entries.key: This invoice has no amount. Enter one in sats.
entries.english: This invoice has no amount. Enter one in sats.
entries.translation: Esta factura no tiene cantidad. Introduce una en sats.

entries.key: Amount must be between {{min}} and {{max}} sats.
entries.english: Amount must be between {{min}} and {{max}} sats.
entries.translation: La cantidad debe estar entre {{min}} y {{max}} sats.

entries.key: Enter a BOLT11 invoice (lnbc…) or a lightning address.
entries.english: Enter a BOLT11 invoice (lnbc…) or a lightning address.
entries.translation: Introduce una factura BOLT11 (lnbc…) o una dirección Lightning.
La billetera no devolvió ninguna factura

entries.key: Your reusable lightning address — anyone can pay it any amount.
entries.english: Your reusable lightning address — anyone can pay it any amount.
entries.translation: Tu dirección Lightning reutilizable — cualquiera puede enviarte cualquier cantidad.

entries.key: Removes this account's saved NWC connection from Sidecar. Your wallet and funds are unaffected.
entries.english: Removes this account's saved NWC connection from Sidecar. Your wallet and funds are unaffected.
entries.translation: Elimina de Sidecar la conexión NWC guardada de esta cuenta. Tu billetera y tus fondos no se ven afectados.
La cantidad debe ser de {{min}}–{{max}} sats

entries.key: This erases everything on this device: all accounts and private keys, wallet connections, per-site permissions, and settings. It cannot be undone. Any account without a backed-up nsec is lost for good.
entries.english: This erases everything on this device: all accounts and private keys, wallet connections, per-site permissions, and settings. It cannot be undone. Any account without a backed-up nsec is lost for good.
entries.translation: Esto borra todo de este dispositivo: todas las cuentas y claves privadas, conexiones de billeteras, permisos por sitio y ajustes. No se puede deshacer. Las cuentas cuyo nsec no tenga copia de seguridad se perderán para siempre.

entries.key: wants to see your public key (npub)
entries.english: wants to see your public key (npub)

entries.key: wants to sign an event with your key
entries.english: wants to sign an event with your key
entries.translation: quiere firmar un evento con tu clave

entries.key: wants to read your relay list
entries.english: wants to read your relay list
entries.translation: quiere leer tu lista de relays

entries.key: wants to see your wallet info
entries.english: wants to see your wallet info
entries.translation: quiere ver la información de tu billetera

entries.key: wants to see your wallet balance
entries.english: wants to see your wallet balance
entries.translation: quiere ver el saldo de tu billetera

entries.key: wants to create a Lightning invoice
entries.english: wants to create a Lightning invoice

entries.key: Deletes other events. Make sure you intended this.
entries.english: Deletes other events. Make sure you intended this.
entries.translation: Elimina otros eventos. Asegúrate de que eso es lo que quieres.

entries.key: Asks relays to delete all of your events. Make sure you intended this.
entries.english: Asks relays to delete all of your events. Make sure you intended this.
entries.translation: Solicita a los relays que eliminen todos tus eventos. Asegúrate de que eso es lo que quieres.

entries.key: Wallet requests are normally signed by the wallet app's own key, not your identity key. Unusual for a site to ask for this.
entries.english: Wallet requests are normally signed by the wallet app's own key, not your identity key. Unusual for a site to ask for this.
entries.translation: Las solicitudes de billetera normalmente se firman con la clave propia de la aplicación de billetera, no con tu clave de identidad. Es inusual que un sitio lo solicite.

entries.key: Wallet responses are normally signed by the wallet app's own key, not your identity key. Unusual for a site to ask for this.
entries.english: Wallet responses are normally signed by the wallet app's own key, not your identity key. Unusual for a site to ask for this.
entries.translation: Las respuestas de billetera normalmente se firman con la clave propia de la aplicación de billetera, no con tu clave de identidad. Es inusual que un sitio lo solicite.

entries.key: This is a remote-signing handshake. Approving it could hand control of your account to another app or device.
entries.english: This is a remote-signing handshake. Approving it could hand control of your account to another app or device.
entries.translation: Este es un acuerdo inicial de firma remota. Aprobarlo podría dar el control de tu cuenta a otra aplicación o dispositivo.

entries.key: Unrecognized event kind. Review carefully before approving.
entries.english: Unrecognized event kind. Review carefully before approving.
entries.translation: Tipo de evento desconocido. Revísalo con cuidado antes de aprobar.

entries.key: This empty list stops every web-of-trust service from scoring for you, including any that another app set up.
entries.english: This empty list stops every web-of-trust service from scoring for you, including any that another app set up.
entries.translation: Esta lista vacía impide que todos los servicios de red de confianza calculen puntuaciones para ti, incluidos los configurados por otras aplicaciones.

entries.key: Sidecar can't read this request as a nostr event. Don't allow it unless you know what this site is doing.
entries.english: Sidecar can't read this request as a nostr event. Don't allow it unless you know what this site is doing.
entries.translation: Sidecar no puede leer esta solicitud como un evento Nostr. No la permitas a menos que sepas qué está haciendo este sitio.

entries.key: This may be another account’s list
entries.english: This may be another account’s list
entries.translation: Esta podría ser la lista de otra cuenta

entries.key: If you didn't mean to do this, don't allow it. The version on your relays stays as it is.
entries.english: If you didn't mean to do this, don't allow it. The version on your relays stays as it is.
entries.translation: Si no era tu intención, no lo permitas. La versión de tus relays no cambiará.

entries.key: Sign in with a different account
entries.english: Sign in with a different account

entries.key: Multiple accounts are signed in here. Confirm who's posting each time.
entries.english: Multiple accounts are signed in here. Confirm who's posting each time.
entries.translation: Hay varias cuentas conectadas aquí. Confirma quién publica cada vez.

entries.key: Allowing lets {{host}} decrypt your messages for about a minute, enough to load a conversation or inbox without asking for each one.
entries.english: Allowing lets {{host}} decrypt your messages for about a minute, enough to load a conversation or inbox without asking for each one.
entries.translation: Al permitirlo, {{host}} podrá descifrar tus mensajes durante aproximadamente un minuto, suficiente para cargar una conversación o bandeja de entrada sin preguntar por cada mensaje.

entries.key: Trust this site and it can read your messages without asking, until you revoke.
entries.english: Trust this site and it can read your messages without asking, until you revoke.
entries.translation: Si confías en este sitio, podrá leer tus mensajes sin preguntar hasta que revoques el permiso.

entries.key: Allowing lets {{host}} read wallet info from Sidecar for the rest of this session.
entries.english: Allowing lets {{host}} read wallet info from Sidecar for the rest of this session.
entries.translation: Al permitirlo, {{host}} podrá leer información de la billetera desde Sidecar durante el resto de esta sesión.

entries.key: A boost is several payments, one per recipient in the show’s split. Set a limit below to cover them all, or Sidecar asks for each one.
entries.english: A boost is several payments, one per recipient in the show’s split. Set a limit below to cover them all, or Sidecar asks for each one.
entries.translation: Un boost consta de varios pagos, uno por destinatario del reparto del programa. Define abajo un límite que los cubra todos o Sidecar preguntará por cada uno.

entries.key: Cancels this request and makes the selected account active.
entries.english: Cancels this request and makes the selected account active.
entries.translation: Cancela esta solicitud y activa la cuenta seleccionada.

entries.key: wants to send a Lightning payment
entries.english: wants to send a Lightning payment

entries.key: Turn on Auto Zaps ({{max}} sats max)
entries.english: Turn on Auto Zaps ({{max}} sats max)

entries.key: Approving this often? Trust {{host}} to stop being asked.
entries.english: Approving this often? Trust {{host}} to stop being asked.
entries.translation: ¿Lo apruebas a menudo? Confía en {{host}} para dejar de recibir preguntas.

entries.key: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
entries.english: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
entries.translation: Demasiados intentos. Vuelve a intentarlo en {{seconds}} s.

entries.key: Enter a budget in sats, or uncheck the box.
entries.english: Enter a budget in sats, or uncheck the box.
entries.translation: Introduce un presupuesto en sats o desmarca la casilla.

entries.key: You're signed in here with more than one account. A client's own account switcher can't tell Sidecar which one you picked, so confirm who's posting each time.
entries.english: You're signed in here with more than one account. A client's own account switcher can't tell Sidecar which one you picked, so confirm who's posting each time.
entries.translation: Has iniciado sesión aquí con varias cuentas. El selector de cuentas del cliente no puede indicar a Sidecar cuál elegiste, así que confirma quién publica cada vez.

entries.key: Camera access was denied. Close this and use "Choose file" instead.
entries.english: Camera access was denied. Close this and use "Choose file" instead.
entries.translation: Se denegó el acceso a la cámara. Cierra esta ventana y usa «Elegir archivo».

entries.key: No camera was found. Close this and use "Choose file" instead.
entries.english: No camera was found. Close this and use "Choose file" instead.
entries.translation: No se encontró ninguna cámara. Cierra esta ventana y usa «Elegir archivo».

entries.key: Couldn't start the camera. Close this and use "Choose file" instead.
entries.english: Couldn't start the camera. Close this and use "Choose file" instead.
entries.translation: No se pudo iniciar la cámara. Cierra esta ventana y usa «Elegir archivo».

entries.key: Point the camera at the QR code on your sheet.
entries.english: Point the camera at the QR code on your sheet.
entries.translation: Apunta la cámara al código QR de tu hoja.

entries.key: Couldn't hand that to Sidecar. Try again.
entries.english: Couldn't hand that to Sidecar. Try again.
entries.translation: No se pudo enviar a Sidecar. Inténtalo de nuevo.

entries.key: Sidecar has no accounts set up yet
entries.english: Sidecar has no accounts set up yet
entries.translation: Sidecar aún no tiene cuentas configuradas
No hay cuenta activa en Sidecar

entries.key: This site is blocked in Sidecar
entries.english: This site is blocked in Sidecar
entries.translation: Este sitio está bloqueado en Sidecar
No hay billetera conectada en Sidecar
No es una factura Lightning BOLT11
No es una URL de imagen legible

entries.key: That QR is not a Lightning invoice
entries.english: That QR is not a Lightning invoice
entries.translation: Ese QR no es una factura Lightning

entries.key: No Lightning invoice found in the selection.
entries.english: No Lightning invoice found in the selection.
entries.translation: No se encontró ninguna factura Lightning en la selección.

entries.key: Clears {{name}}’s trust provider list, for every web-of-trust service it names.
entries.english: Clears {{name}}’s trust provider list, for every web-of-trust service it names.
entries.translation: Borra la lista de proveedores de confianza de {{name}} para todos los servicios de red de confianza que incluye.

entries.key: Clears your trust provider list, for every web-of-trust service it names.
entries.english: Clears your trust provider list, for every web-of-trust service it names.
entries.translation: Borra tu lista de proveedores de confianza para todos los servicios de red de confianza que incluye.
Reduce los seguidos de {{name}} de {{from}} a {{to}}.
Reduce la lista de silenciados de {{name}} de {{from}} a {{to}}.

entries.key: Drops your mute list from {{from}} to {{to}}.
entries.english: Drops your mute list from {{from}} to {{to}}.
entries.translation: Reduce tu lista de silenciados de {{from}} a {{to}}.

entries.key: At least 8 characters. There is no recovery if you forget it.
entries.english: At least 8 characters. There is no recovery if you forget it.
entries.translation: Al menos 8 caracteres. No se puede recuperar si lo olvidas.

entries.key: Searches an index that covers everyone. It sees what you type and who you follow.
entries.english: Searches an index that covers everyone. It sees what you type and who you follow.
entries.translation: Busca en un índice que incluye a todos. Puede ver lo que escribes y a quién sigues.

entries.key: Show a floating “Pay with Sidecar” button when a page displays a Lightning invoice.
entries.english: Show a floating “Pay with Sidecar” button when a page displays a Lightning invoice.
entries.translation: Muestra un botón flotante «Pagar con Sidecar» cuando una página muestra una factura Lightning.

entries.key: Offered as a preset wherever you send a zap. Set for the account you are in.
entries.english: Offered as a preset wherever you send a zap. Set for the account you are in.
entries.translation: Se ofrece como opción al enviar un zap. Se configura para la cuenta actual.

entries.key: Zaps under these limits need no approval. Capped at 1,000 sats a zap, 100,000 a day.
entries.english: Zaps under these limits need no approval. Capped at 1,000 sats a zap, 100,000 a day.
entries.translation: Los zaps bajo estos límites no necesitan aprobación. Máximo de 1.000 sats por zap y 100.000 al día.

entries.key: Covers zaps you start in a client. Other payments use a site's budget.
entries.english: Covers zaps you start in a client. Other payments use a site's budget.
entries.translation: Incluye los zaps que inicias en un cliente. Los demás pagos usan el presupuesto del sitio.

entries.key: Even on Never, your PIN is asked once per browser session.
entries.english: Even on Never, your PIN is asked once per browser session.
entries.translation: Incluso con Nunca, se pide tu PIN una vez por sesión del navegador.
Copia de seguridad de la bóveda

entries.key: Every account's key and wallet in one encrypted file, not a single account's nsec.
entries.english: Every account's key and wallet in one encrypted file, not a single account's nsec.
entries.translation: Las claves y billeteras de todas las cuentas en un archivo cifrado, no el nsec de una sola cuenta.

entries.key: Erases every account, key and wallet on this device. Cannot be undone — back up your nsecs first.
entries.english: Erases every account, key and wallet on this device. Cannot be undone — back up your nsecs first.
entries.translation: Borra todas las cuentas, claves y billeteras de este dispositivo. No se puede deshacer: guarda primero tus nsecs.

entries.key: Offer Sidecar on sites like this
entries.english: Offer Sidecar on sites like this
entries.translation: Ofrecer Sidecar en sitios como este

entries.key: Allow this site to spend up to
entries.english: Allow this site to spend up to
entries.translation: Permitir que este sitio gaste hasta

entries.context: The extension's name, as the browser and the add-on stores show it. Keep "Sidecar" untranslated; the part after the bar may be translated.
entries.translation: Sidecar | Un firmador Nostr con estilo

entries.english: A multi-account NIP-07 Nostr signer with a built-in Lightning wallet, in your browser sidebar.
entries.context: One line under the name in the browser's extension list and the store listings. Keep "NIP-07", "Nostr" and "Lightning" as written.
entries.translation: Un firmador Nostr NIP-07 multicuenta con billetera Lightning integrada, en la barra lateral de tu navegador.

entries.context: Tooltip on the toolbar button.
Title of the sidebar in Firefox. The product name, not translated.
The corner pill for a Lightning invoice found on a web page. AMOUNT is the number, shown in bold.
The same pill for an invoice with no amount of its own.

entries.english: $AMOUNT$ sat Lightning invoice is payable on $SITE$. Open Sidecar to pay it.
entries.context: Screen-reader label for the pill. SITE is the web page's host.
entries.translation: Hay una factura Lightning de $AMOUNT$ sats por pagar en $SITE$. Abre Sidecar para pagarla.

entries.english: A Lightning invoice is payable on $SITE$. Open Sidecar to pay it.
entries.context: Screen-reader label for the pill when the invoice has no amount.
entries.translation: Hay una factura Lightning por pagar en $SITE$. Abre Sidecar para pagarla.

entries.context: Screen-reader label for the pill's close button.
Screen-reader label for the close button on the payment-in-progress pill. Hides the indicator; it does not cancel the payment.
The corner pill while a payment is going out. AMOUNT in bold.
The same pill for an automatic zap.
The pill while a payment with no stated amount goes out.
The same, for an automatic zap.
The pill once the payment has settled. AMOUNT in bold.
A payment has settled.
Small heading on the payment card. A REQUEST, not a charge: nothing has been paid yet. Keep that sense.
The unit under the amount on the payment card (satoshis).

entries.english: A Lightning invoice. Choose the amount in Sidecar.
entries.context: Shown on the card for an invoice with no amount of its own.
entries.translation: Una factura Lightning. Elige el importe en Sidecar.

entries.english: Turn on Auto Zaps ($MAX$ sats max)
entries.context: Switch on the card that turns on automatic zaps up to MAX.
Screen-reader label for the payment card.
Under the amount: where the invoice was found. SITE in bold.
The card's pay button. Pressing it asks Sidecar; nothing is sent until approved there.
Closes the card without paying.
Switch that stops the card appearing for invoices found on pages.
entries.translation: No volver a mostrar este aviso

entries.context: The pay button while Sidecar asks for approval.

entries.english: Approve it in Sidecar to send it. Nothing has left your wallet yet.
entries.context: Status under the button while waiting for approval. Must stay clear that nothing has been paid yet.
entries.translation: Apruébalo en Sidecar para enviarlo. Todavía no ha salido nada de tu billetera.

entries.context: The pay button after a payment failed.
Shown when a payment fails with no reason given.
entries.translation: El pago falló. Inténtalo de nuevo.

entries.context: On the pay card: hands the invoice to whichever Lightning app is registered on this computer instead of paying with Sidecar.
Heading of the pay card when it is offered on a site not signed in with Sidecar, after the person taps a Lightning link.
On the offer card: stop offering to pay Lightning links on sites not signed in with Sidecar.
